citations.name: requirements.sdk.domain
citations.commentary:
An *application domain* is the application's graph, node contents, and evidence
storage, made available together for criterion execution. In the SDK, it
implements [`Domain`](../rustdocs/trust_but_verify/trait.Domain.html) to supply
its shared types, node and edge operations, and evidence persistence.

rationale: The commentary is a `{cite}` of `requirements.sdk.domain`, and explanatory prose is the right role for it. It doesn't contradict the requirement. The requirement says every application domain implements `trust_but_verify::Domain`, and the commentary says the same thing and links to the `Domain` trait. The requirement also says the trait's members are introduced "one capability at a time". That fits the commentary's summary that `Domain` supplies shared types, node and edge operations, and evidence persistence. The requirement doesn't list those capabilities itself. Other prose in the same section ties node reads, edge queries and evidence persistence to `Domain`. The commentary adds no claim the requirement forbids. The item has no `{impl}` or `{test}` reference to the same requirement, so the citation isn't redundant.
